entries: Is this a dream? How can this place be real?
这是梦吗？这种地方怎么会真实存在？
These companions of mine will be the death of me.
我这些同伴，早晚要了我的命。
Surely this is a home for many monsters.
这里肯定是许多怪物的家园。
I did not know one could remain in this place for more than an instant.
我都不知道人竟能在此处停留超过一瞬。
There is a rythym in the air, but it is chaos, not music.
空气中有种节律，但那是混沌，不是音乐。
How to say of this place... not enough.... exist?
怎么说这地方……不够……存在？
There are stars all around. This place is like a deep sleep.
四周都是星辰。这里像一场深眠。
Is this where arcane power comes from? Or is it just a conduit?
奥术之力源自这里吗？还是说，这里只是一条导管？
What manner of things will we find here?
我们会在这里遇到什么样的东西？
Can one visit this place and leave sane?
来过这里的人，还能清醒地离开吗？
This place is lonely. I do not like it.
这地方太孤单了。我不喜欢。
I wonder if my cousins are here. I hope they are not.
不知道我的同族们在不在。但愿不在。
Let us forge a path of knowing into this unknown.
让我们在这片未知中踏出一条求知之路。
I wish to sing, if only to drown out the maddening noise that I hear.
我想唱歌——哪怕只是为了盖过耳边那令人发狂的杂音。
Will never feel right... knowing of this place.
知道有这种地方存在……永远都让人不自在。
Gems! Jewels! I must restrain myself, or fall into the void.
宝石！珠宝！我得克制住自己，否则就要坠入虚空了。
More than I ever imagined... or feared.
超乎我的想象……也超乎我的恐惧。
What was this supposed to be? A dungeon? A home?
这里本该是什么？地牢？还是家？
This place could use some redecorating.
这地方真该重新装修一下。
Fae not meant to wander halls. Sadness seeps in.
妖精不该徘徊于厅堂。哀愁渗进来了。
Why were all of these places made underground in the first place?
这些地方当初为什么要建在地下？
I had better hum a tune before I get depressed.
趁还没抑郁，我最好哼支小曲。
Human world sad. Need more damp. More mushroom.
人类的世界，悲伤。需要更多潮气。更多蘑菇。
All paths lead to darkness. This place is a graveyard. There had better be treasure.
所有路都通向黑暗。这里就是座坟场。最好有点宝藏。
When I last wandered these halls they were no better.
我上次在这些厅堂里游荡时，它们也没好到哪去。
I do tire of caves, but... this is truly amazing.
洞穴我是真腻了，不过……这儿真是壮观。
Things I did not expect to see number one-hundred and one...
我没想到会见到的东西，第一百零一件……
There are runes here. Can feel them.
This will end with all of us soaking wet, won't it?
最后我们肯定个个都得湿透，对吧？
There is a hum, coming from those blue mushrooms. How odd.
那些蓝色蘑菇里传来嗡鸣。真古怪。
This place of danger. Smash all mushroom.
危险之地。砸掉所有蘑菇。
I guess staying dry is out of the question. At least
看来保持干燥是没指望了。至少——
You are playing this game out of order, friend.
朋友，你这挑战顺序不太对呀。
Is there any end to the wonders we will see?
我们将见到的奇景，有尽头吗？
Living underground would not be so bad here, I suppose.
住在这种地方的地下，倒也不算太糟。
我在这里感觉到米亚拉。
This sight puts me at ease. That is a dangerous.
这番景色让我安心。而这，恰恰很危险。
Never see such thing. Can touch it?
从没见过这种东西。能摸吗？
If there is ore in there, I aim to find it.
那里面要是有矿，我非找出来不可。
Is it arcane in some way, but not like most magic.
它带着某种奥术气息，却又不像寻常魔法。
It's a wonder the house hasn't fallen into this place.
那房子没塌进这里，真是个奇迹。
Something tells me this is more than just a root cellar.
直觉告诉我，这里可不只是一间储菜窖。
Oh look. A completely normal dungeon under a house. Everything is fine.
哦，看哪。一栋房子下面有座完全正常的地牢。一切都好。
There is a presence here that I cannot place.
这里有一种我说不清的存在感。
If the home owners cannot remember much, do they even know this is here?
要是屋主自己都记不清事，他们还知道这里的存在吗？
I feel a bit like we're trespassing. That is what we're doing right?
我有点觉得我们是在私闯民宅。我们确实是在闯，对吧？
Coorou! Finally human with good sense. Would live here.
咕噜！终于有个明白人。我愿意住这儿。
Let's hope there are no spiders.
Fascinating. This cellar was hidden on purpose but appears long forgotten.
有意思。这间地窖是故意藏起来的，看来却早已被遗忘。
I think we all know what awaits us here.
我想我们都清楚这里等着我们的是什么。
I have seen crypts more inviting than this.
我见过比这儿更宜人的墓室。
Don't get me wrong... I like slaying monsters, but this place gives me the creeps.
别误会……我喜欢斩妖除魔，但这地方让我发毛。
Ancient things are here. Two of them.
这里有古老的东西。两件。
And I thought the crypt was bad.
我还以为那座墓室就够糟了。
Scaphin avoid this. Scaphin wise in this matter.
斯卡芬，躲开这里。这件事上，斯卡芬很明智。
And... back in I go. I am a glutton for punishment I guess.
然后……我又进去了。看来我真是自讨苦吃的命。
Man left this place ages ago. Now something else lives here. Yet, I feel some other presence.
人类很久以前就离开了这里。如今另有什么住在这儿。可我还能感觉到另一种存在。
There is no way across that I can see.
我看不出有任何办法过去。
I have spent far too much time peering over chasms.
我在悬崖边张望的时间已经太久了。
Dark things beyond, but humans cannot pass this way.
对面有黑暗之物。但人类过不去。
Maybe if we jump... maybe not.
Oh no... now we can't go deeper into a hideous spider lair.
哦不……现在我们没法再深入那个恶心的蜘蛛巢穴了。
No like. Summjah... must turn back.
不，喜欢不起来。萨姆贾……必须回头。
I have no qualms about turning back after seeing what put me in that cocoon.
见过把我裹进茧里的东西之后，回头我毫无意见。
We should start carring a ladder or something.
我们真该随身带把梯子什么的。
Is that a... person in the crystal?
I see a figure in the crystal.
我看到水晶里有个人影。
Is someone trapped in that crystal? We must help.
有人被困在水晶里吗？我们得去救。
A Tale of Many Facets... no no.. that does not sound right.
《多面传说》……不不，总觉得不对味。
Look at the size of that crystal. And... what is that inside?
看那块水晶的尺寸。而且……里面是什么？
We draw closer to whatever lurks here...
我们离潜伏在此的东西越来越近了……
A dark termor emanates from here.
一种黑暗的震颤从这里散发出来。
I can feel another world. This should not be.
我能感觉到另一个世界。这本不该存在。
Bravery is a repeatable action, if one is careful.
只要够小心，勇敢是可以重复使用的动作。
A song can only be sung if we survive.
只有活下来，才能把歌继续唱下去。
So many crystal! Worth dry air to see this sight.
好多水晶！为看这景象，空气干燥也值了。
By the moons... I have never seen such a thing in all my days.
月亮在上……我这一生都没见过这样的东西。
There is something unnatural here. Take care friends.
这里有违常理之物。小心点，朋友们。
I wonder why this place is abandoned.
这地方为什么被废弃了呢。
I feel the call of something dark here. Let's kill it.
我感觉到黑暗之物在呼唤。去宰了它。
It must have taken many men or many years to hollow ths out.
凿空这里，要么用了很多人，要么用了很多年。
I sense an opportunity for a new song.
我感觉到一首新歌的机会。
How men make cave? Too dry.
人类怎么挖的洞？太干了。
The gems and ore found making this place must have been vast.
开挖这里时找到的宝石与矿石想必极多。
I can feel the energy in this place.
我能感觉到这地方的能量。
我们就非得一直待在地下吗？
This place is a home to many creatures.
这地方是许多生物的家。
How can there be so much beneath this one village?
这一个小村子底下，怎么会藏着这么多东西？
Did someone light a mildew scented candle?
是谁点了支霉味的蜡烛吗？
Miss home, but heart want adventure.
This is not a place of fond memories for me. But the treasure was good!
这地方对我来说没什么好回忆。不过宝藏是真不错！
In times of need, trust is important. But be on your guard.
危急之时，信任很重要。但也要保持警惕。
I wish to make known my objection to this idea.
我想正式声明：我反对这个主意。
This may end up being a terrible choice.
这可能是个糟糕透顶的选择。
Fear not. They are not as the others.
别怕。它们和其他那些不一样。
I am afraid of heights. There, I said it.
I wonder what is down there?
How I join you if you not find me yet?
你们还没找到我，我怎么加入你们？
I was hoping to leave the caves, not go deeper in...
我是想离开洞穴，不是越钻越深……
Imagine this was your whole world, not knowing what was above. Are we the same?
想象这就是你的整个世界，不知道上方有什么。我们是一样的吗？
How can all this this exist under the village?
这村子底下怎么会藏着这一切？
I prefer to stay on the dry paths, of possible.
可能的话，我宁可走干燥的路。
Full of life. Full of danger.
So many sounds are echoing in this place. It is disorienting.
这么多声音在这里回荡。让人发晕。
Will miss this place. Return, one day.
会想念这里。总有一天，回来。
The greatest miner and sculptor has always been water.
最伟大的矿工与雕刻家，从来都是水。
I prefer places more dry. But I cannot help but feel the magic of this place.
我更偏爱干燥的地方。可这里的魔力实在让人无法忽视。
Is there any end to the wonders we will see?
我们将见到的奇景，有尽头吗？
Living underground would not be so bad here, I suppose.
住在这种地方的地下，倒也不算太糟。
我在这里感觉到米亚拉。
This sight puts me at ease. That is a dangerous.
这番景色让我安心。而这，恰恰很危险。
Never see such thing. Can touch it?
从没见过这种东西。能摸吗？
If there is ore in there, I aim to find it.
那里面要是有矿，我非找出来不可。
Is it arcane in some way, but not like most magic.
它带着某种奥术气息，却又不像寻常魔法。
What was the purpose of this hall?
这座大厅当初是做什么用的？
Someone had a lot of time on their hands.
当年的人可真是闲得慌。
Have these architects ever heard of railings?
这些建筑师听说过「栏杆」这东西吗？
This was a gathering place... I can sense it.
这里曾是聚会之所……我能感觉到。
I do not mind long halls and deep chasms so long as they are empty.
只要空无一物，长厅深壑我都不介意。
So many sounds are echoing in this place. It is disorienting.
这么多声音在这里回荡。让人发晕。
Humans make rock into more. But why?
人类把石头变成「更多」。可是，为什么？
I wonder if they had to mine these chasms, or if they were natural.
不知道这些深壑是人工开凿的，还是天然形成的。
I gazed at this hall before I left. I never did expect to return.
离开前我曾凝望这座大厅。从没想过还能回来。
Those evil echoes from the deep are prominent here.
深处的邪恶回响在这里格外清晰。
There is definitely something down there.
I wonder what treasures lie below?
I believe we are right above the Shelter.
我确信我们就在庇护所正上方。
Did he seal himself in there?
他把自己封在里面了吗？
I think it was locked from this side...
我觉得是从这一侧锁上的……
I could never make that jump.
I would fly across, but I must not leave you.
我本可以飞过去，但我不能丢下你们。
You are going to have to throw me.
If only we had a rope.
Can jump. But not want to. No scared.
能跳。但不想跳。不是害怕。
If I fall, I'll likely get stuck on my way down.
我要是掉下去，八成会卡在半路。
Will we be stopped by a mere chasm! Yes.
区区一道深渊就想拦住我们！会的。
Is there any end to the wonders we will see?
我们将见到的奇景，有尽头吗？
Living underground would not be so bad here, I suppose.
住在这种地方的地下，倒也不算太糟。
我在这里感觉到米亚拉。
This sight puts me at ease. That is a dangerous.
这番景色让我安心。而这，恰恰很危险。

从没见过这种东西。能摸吗？

Is it arcane in some way, but not like most magic.
它带着某种奥术气息，却又不像寻常魔法。
I thought we had found a way around it...
我还以为我们找到绕过去的路了……
I, for one, am not surprised. Anyone else?
反正我一点都不惊讶。还有谁？
My friends cannot follow me there.
我的朋友们跟不进去那里。
Why were we allowed to come this far?
他们为什么放任我们走到这么远？
There is a reason. But can we can figure it out?
一定有原因。可我们猜得出来吗？
Still no see fog. Wish there was fog, Need moisture.
还是没看到雾。希望有雾。需要水汽。
The deeper I peer into it... the less I see.
我往里看得越深……看到的越少。
We can go no further. Perhaps there is purpose in our inconvenience.
我们过不去了。也许这份受阻自有其意义。
I ignored the elders once. I will not do it again.
我曾无视过长老的告诫。不会再有第二次。
I did not come out of the darkness only to disappear into the mist.
我走出黑暗，可不是为了消失在迷雾里。
That's a big no for me.
My companions cannot follow. I will not leave them behind.
我的同伴们过不去。我绝不抛下他们。
This fog must be understood before we can face it.
在直面这片迷雾之前，必须先弄懂它。
I would rather sing songs about it than find out for myself.
比起亲身试探，我更愿意为它写首歌。
What fog? No see fog. Want go. *Sigh*
什么雾？没看到雾。想进去。*叹息*
It is cloudy, like a polished moonstone. Beautiful.
它雾蒙蒙的，像一枚打磨过的月长石。真美。
Wisdom bids us not to enter the mist, lest we share the fate of these travellers.
智慧劝诫我们不可踏入迷雾，免得重蹈这些旅人的覆辙。
I am not looking forward to what we must do here.
我一点都不期待我们接下来必须做的事。
Somethig is off about this place.
My kind once frequented this place.
How dreary. Perhaps some music would liven this place up.
真沉闷。也许来点音乐能让这里热闹起来。
Scaphin no bury, since caves already underground.
斯卡芬不埋人。反正洞，已经在地下。
Think of all the loot that these people do not need anymore.
想想这些人再也用不上的所有东西（战利品）。
How have you met me, and are just getting to this place?
你都见到我了，怎么才走到这地方？

Wisdom bids us not to enter the mist, lest we share the fate of these travellers.
智慧劝诫我们不可踏入迷雾，免得重蹈这些旅人的覆辙。
I ignored the elders once. I will not do it again.
我曾无视过长老的告诫。不会再有第二次。
I did not come out of the darkness only to disappear into the mist.
我走出黑暗，可不是为了消失在迷雾里。
That's a big no for me.
My companions cannot follow. I will not leave them behind.
我的同伴们过不去。我绝不抛下他们。
This fog must be understood before we can face it.
在直面这片迷雾之前，必须先弄懂它。
I would rather sing songs about it than find out for myself.
比起亲身试探，我更愿意为它写首歌。
What fog? No see fog. Want go. *Sigh*
什么雾？没看到雾。想进去。*叹息*

I suppose we are destined to crawl through the darkness.
看来我们注定要在黑暗里爬行。
I suppose you want us to go in there?
我猜你是想让我们进去？
Oh, look! A dark crevice! How inviting.
哦，看哪！一道黑暗的裂隙！真是盛情相邀。
I do not like the idea of going in there.
我不喜欢进那里面的主意。
You don't seriously want to go in there do you?
有黑暗的地方，就有宝石！
Why is there no fog here? Can we actually leave?
这里为什么没有雾？我们真能离开了吗？
Somehow no fog seems more ominous than fog everywhere else.
不知怎的，没有雾反而比到处是雾更让人不安。
There is probably a really good reason why there is no fog at this exit. Probably.
这个出口没有雾，肯定有个很充分的理由。大概吧。
The hills are this way. Fae once lived there.
丘陵往这边。妖精曾住在那里。
I look forward to seeing more green grass instead of dark stone.
我期待看到更多青草，而不是黑石。
This is the way I came into town, but I thought there was fog here.
我就是从这条路进镇的，可我记得这里有雾啊。
Scaphin not know much of human world. All very strange.
斯卡芬，不懂人类世界。一切，都很怪。
There are old mines out this way. I vote to visit them.
这边有废弃的老矿。我提议去看看。

A campfire indoors? That seems dangerous.
屋里的营火？看着挺危险。
There is something off about this home.
这座房子里有点不对劲。
Still better home than a crypt. Even if it might burn down.
总比住在墓室里强。哪怕它可能被烧掉。
A little music would liven this place up. A lively song next to the campfire anyone?
来点音乐能让这儿热闹起来。谁想在营火旁听首欢快的歌？
Wooden house too fragile. Wood burn. Stone not burn.
木头房子，太脆弱。木头会烧。石头不会烧。
I wonder if anyone left anything valuable here.
不知道有没有人在这里留下值钱的东西。
I feel a strange connection to this place.
我对这地方有种奇特的联系感。
Places like this are not for me.
I have never been able to enter this place before.
我以前从没能进入这个地方。
I feel a faint presence. Very faint.
我感觉到微弱的存在。非常微弱。
There is  a peace in that place.
Safe. That is the word I would use to describe this place.
安全。如果要用一个词形容这里，那就是它。
There is an aura of protection here.
这里萦绕着守护的气息。
There is power here. A good power.
这里有力量。一种良善的力量。
There is a music to the light in here. How strange.
这里的光仿佛自带音乐。真奇怪。
Feel welcome. Not feel this from other human places.
感到被欢迎。在别的人类地方，没有这种感觉。
I promise I will not go looking for gems. Probably.
我保证不去找宝石。大概吧。
There are many kinds of power. This one is not quite arcane.
力量有许多种。这一种不太像奥术。
I did not know this many books even existed.
我都不知道世上竟有这么多书。
It saddens me to see so many books unread... but why?
看到这么多书无人翻阅，真让人难过……可这是为什么呢？
This is a home for monsters now.
这里现在是怪物的家了。
I do not think a book has been checked out in a long time.
我觉得已经很久没有书被借出去过了。
It is like a crypt, but dressed up.
这像座墓室，只是打扮得体面些。
Normally I am comfortable indoors, but this is worse than a root cellar.
平时我在室内挺自在的，但这地方比储菜窖还糟。
What this place? Why humans so strange?
这地方，是什么？为什么人类，这么奇怪？
As musty as it is, I don't see any spiders. That is either very good, or very bad.
虽然霉味熏人，但这里看不到蜘蛛。这要么是好事，要么糟透了。
